slides.title: Ethiopia's food aid is running short
slides.body: WFP's new country brief, reported by The Reporter

slides.title: needed by WFP over the next six months
slides.body: Its requirements are only 46 percent funded, the agency's October brief says.

slides.title: people reached with food in September
slides.body: up from 1.9 million in August, according to WFP.

slides.title: cereal rations, about 9 kg per person
slides.body: WFP kept cereal at reduced rations while keeping full pulses and oil.

slides.title: refugees assisted across 30 camps
slides.body: Long-term refugees get only 60 percent rations because of budget limits, WFP said.

slides.title: Conflict and drought block deliveries
slides.body: Insecurity, fuel shortages and blocked roads delayed aid in Afar, Tigray and parts of Amhara, the brief says.

slides.title: Let food aid reach every civilian.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
